payload.name: dispute_charge
payload.description: Handle a guest dispute on a line item.

category.description: Pick the category that best matches what the caller is disputing.
category.title: Category

line_item_label.description: The label of the line item on the invoice, as it appears.
line_item_label.title: Line Item Label

caller_note.description: A short summary of what the caller said about the charge.
caller_note.title: Caller Note

accepts_offered_resolution.description:
Required. Set true ONLY after the caller has actually
accepted the policy outcome you offered (a goodwill waiver, a credit, etc.).
Set false if they pushed back, asked for a manager, or haven't been offered
anything yet. Never default to true to skip the conversation.
accepts_offered_resolution.title: Accepts Offered Resolution
